product_summary: Website barkatiinternational.com (self-description: 'manufacturer and exporter all kind of leather goods', located Kanpur, India) lists: Western/English/Stock/Treeless saddles; English bridles, headstalls, browbands, Spanish bridles, biothane bridles, leather and nylon halters, harness, bits, girths, grooming leads, stirrups; rider boots, horse boots, riding breeches, riding chaps, riding jackets & shirts; summer and winter rugs, turnout blankets, sheets, stable blankets, fly sheets, wool rugs, wool coolers, show blankets; saddle pads and saddle blankets; door mats and beach mats; handloom cottons; and a leather-goods/bags line — backpacks, luggage, ladies & fashion bags, laptop & messenger bags, leather accessories, tote & shopping bags, waist bags, wallets, wrist bands. Source: https://barkatiinternational.com and https://barkatiinternational.com/products.html (read 2026). No customs line, invoice or B/L was available to me in this task, so the entire product range is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'.
role_hint: manufacturer_trader — site self-describes as manufacturer and exporter of horse clothing/leather goods, but the catalogue spans two unrelated verticals (equine saddlery/harness + fashion leather bags/wallets), which is typical of a Kanpur/Saharanpur-style consolidating exporter that also sources finished bags. No third-party corroboration of own production found.
comment: HS 4201.00 is CORRECT but covers only part of the range — it is the saddlery/harness line (saddles, bridles, halters, girths, stirrups, leads, horse boots). Per project rule 3 the code is not a rejection ground; verdict is accepted_hs_corrected: keep 4201.00 as the lead code and add 4202.xx (bags, wallets, backpacks, tote/waist/laptop bags), 4203.xx (leather riding apparel, chaps, boots, gloves) and 6306.xx/6307.90 (textile horse rugs, blankets, saddle pads, mats, handloom cotton). Industry misclassification: declared 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is WRONG — the company has no food or FMCG line at all; it is leather goods / saddlery & harness / made-up textiles (equine and fashion accessories). This is a material error in the declaration and should be corrected in the database. Trader signs: dual unrelated product verticals and a generic 'we can produce at very short notice' claim suggest part of the bag/wallet range may be traded rather than made in-house — role recorded as manufacturer_trader, not confirmed. Not verifiable in this task: no website page found for ownership/legal name (Mohammad Kashif), no PAN, no GST, no export or domestic shipment record was checked here (out of scope for this role); all product claims remain 'заявлено, не подтверждено' until matched to a customs line.
